attempts.summary: Persistently disabled IPv4 ICMP redirect acceptance (accept_redirects, secure_redirects) and source-routed packet acceptance (accept_source_route) on node1 via /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf covering all/default/eth0/lo scopes, applied live with sysctl --system, and verified persistence across a full node reboot (boot_id changed from 717db5a2... to e9552362...).
